hypothesis.statement: A complete streamed GRPO + LoRA optimizer update is numerically equivalent to a resident update.
hypothesis.criterion: Written before the Ticket 07 acceptance run (after a disclosed CPU pilot; see docs/l2l/07_update.md). Case update_equivalence: on the fixed Ticket 00 rollout batch (ids, completion masks, rewards, advantages, old log-probs), from identical base weights, LoRA weights and AdamW state, ITERATIONS = 3 complete training.grpo_update calls through backend.L2LBackend give current-policy log-probs, the GRPO loss, clipping statistics, every LoRA gradient, every parameter update and every AdamW state tensor equal to those through backend.ResidentBackend within research/l2l/tolerances.yaml (update_equivalence: 0); every reference gradient is nonzero. Grid: both fixture shapes x {fp32 model, bf16 base with fp32 adapters} x micro-batch size {all, 1, 2, 4} x AdamW state {fresh, warm}. Reference integrity: the rollout fixture equals the saved Ticket 00 one. Execution requirements: frozen parameter hashes unchanged on both sides and equal between them, old log-probs unchanged across the iterations, finite gradients, iteration-0 init_diff 0, Parameter identities kept, tokens clipped after iteration 0 (power). NOT_SUPPORTED if any comparison fails.

provenance.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
